ModMetadata.Name: Controls Plus
ModMetadata.Author: James
ModMetadata.Description:
This is a Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
[h1]Controls Plus[/h1] Adds two convenient, fully rebindable controls:
[list] [*]Toggle worn sensor lenses on or off (default F7) [*]Equip or stow the first normal or advanced tablet in your inventory (default F8) [/list]
Both shortcuts appear under the Controls Plus group in the normal Controls settings.
Controls Plus is client-side. Dedicated servers and other players do not need to install it.
Source code and issue tracker: [url=https://github.com/jameslkingsley/ControlsPlus]github.com/jameslkingsley/ControlsPlus[/url]
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 0.1.0[/h3] [list] [*]Initial release [*]Sensor-lenses on/off shortcut [*]Tablet and Advanced Tablet equip/stow shortcut [/list]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
<size="30"><color=#ffa500>Controls Plus</color></size>
Adds rebindable shortcuts for toggling sensor lenses and equipping or stowing normal and advanced tablets. This is a client-side mod.
Defaults: F7 for sensor lenses and F8 for tablets. Rebind them under Controls Plus in the Controls settings.
Source: https://github.com/jameslkingsley/ControlsPlus
